Dear sports friends,
Welcome to the world of Bicycle Line Srl where the BL brand represents excellence in 
technical sportswear for various disciplines. Founded in 1987, our family-owned Italian 
company based in Treviso has inherited a passion passed down from generation to 
generation, consistently guaranteeing the highest quality in its production.
Starting from our roots in the heart of the Veneto region, we have achieved a leading 
position at the international level. Our presence is not limited to Italy but extends to 
major European countries and beyond where we are recognized as synonymous with 
quality and reliability in the world of sports.
Our experience combined with in-house production management and the collaboration 
of a highly qualified team allows us to guarantee impeccable service to our clients. 
From customizing orders with a minimum of just 10 pieces to creating 3D prototypes, 
we stand by your side at every stage of the process while ensuring deadlines are met.
Each piece in our range results from careful design work, crafted with selected mate￾rials to ensure optimal performance in all situations. Thanks to production in our 
factories, we control all stages to ensure maximum quality in our products.
Regarding craftsmanship, we combine traditional methods with cutting-edge technolo￾gies to offer excellent garments. Our constant research leads to the use of latest-gene￾ration fabrics characterized by their breathability, weather resistance, and durability.
Thank you for choosing BL as your partner for quality technical sportswear. We 
accompany you in achieving your sporting successes.

Technology and innovation
When you are looking for the right match between push and comfort.
Cycling is an all-round world and takes every aspect into account. This is why we collaborate with Cytech, 
an excellence in the production of pads that includes Elastic Interface and Berenis brands, to combine our 
style with the top of stability.
Cytech technology includes over 40 different types of pads created to measure for male fit and 35 speci￾fic for female fit, designed ad hoc for different disciplines. The foam design is made according to the

exposed to pressure and chafing.
Behind each pad there is a world of analysis, selection of materials, construction techniques, study of 
posture, balance of comfort and performance.
